roadmap.freeStart: Google Analytics, IBM SkillsBuild Data, Alteryx Core
roadmap.paidAdd: PL-300, Tableau Data Analyst, Google BI
roadmap.portfolio: Power BI/Tableau dashboards, SQL queries, KPI memo
roadmap.pitch: I can convert raw data into management decisions.

roadmap.freeStart: IBM AI Fundamentals, Microsoft Applied Skills
roadmap.paidAdd: Microsoft AI Business Professional, AI Transformation Leader, Google GenAI Leader
roadmap.portfolio: AI ROI model, governance framework, automation prototype
roadmap.pitch: I can identify AI use cases and convert them into measurable business value.

roadmap.paidAdd: Meta Digital Marketing Associate, Hootsuite if needed
roadmap.portfolio: Paid campaign plan, SEO audit, GA4 dashboard
roadmap.pitch: I can improve CAC, conversion and marketing ROI.

roadmap.portfolio: CRM process map, Salesforce demo org, RevOps dashboard

roadmap.freeStart: Atlassian Jira, Pendo PLG, Amplitude badges
roadmap.paidAdd: PSM I, PSPO I, Google PM
roadmap.portfolio: PRD, backlog, product analytics case, Jira board
roadmap.pitch: I can manage delivery and product decisions with data.

roadmap.freeStart: QuickBooks, Bloomberg if campus access, finance free courses
roadmap.portfolio: Financial model, budget dashboard, valuation note
roadmap.pitch: I can connect finance models with business analytics.

roadmap.freeStart: CSSC White Belt, SAP Learning, Power Automate basics
roadmap.portfolio: DMAIC project, process map, automation workflow
roadmap.pitch: I can quantify process savings and automate workflows.

roadmap.paidAdd: UCI HR Analytics, Power BI, SAP SuccessFactors
roadmap.pitch: I can make HR decisions measurable and data-driven.

roadmap.freeStart: ISC2 CC if free voucher available, Google Cybersecurity audit
roadmap.portfolio: Risk register, controls matrix, incident memo
roadmap.pitch: I can connect business risk with cyber controls.

roadmap.paidAdd: AI/Analytics/CRM stack based on target role
roadmap.portfolio: Consulting slide deck and case writeups
roadmap.pitch: I can solve ambiguous business problems and communicate recommendations.

paths.stack: PL-300 + Google BI + Alteryx Core + GA4
paths.portfolio: 4 dashboards, SQL queries, business insight memo, stakeholder presentation
paths.employers: Big 4, analytics consulting, SaaS analytics teams, GCCs
paths.ctcLogic: 30+ LPA usually needs strong portfolio + internship/live project + interview case performance, not certificate alone
paths.action: Weeks 1-4 Power BI, Weeks 5-8 SQL/BI projects, Weeks 9-12 portfolio + case interviews

paths.stack: Salesforce Associate + Salesforce BA + HubSpot RevOps + Jira
paths.portfolio: Salesforce process map, BRD, user stories, reports, demo org
paths.employers: Salesforce partners, SaaS firms, IT services, consulting firms
paths.ctcLogic: CRM consulting can scale fast because domain + process + tool skills combine
paths.action: Weeks 1-2 Trailhead, Weeks 3-7 Salesforce projects, Weeks 8-12 BA case portfolio

paths.stack: Microsoft AI Business Professional + AI Transformation Leader + Google GenAI Leader + BCG GenAI simulation
paths.portfolio: AI use-case portfolio, ROI model, governance/risk checklist, board-style deck
paths.employers: Consulting firms, enterprise digital offices, SaaS companies, AI startups
paths.ctcLogic: Higher CTC comes from ability to convert AI hype into measurable business cases
paths.action: Complete 3 AI strategy cases across HR, marketing and operations

paths.stack: Google Ads Search + Measurement + GA4 + Meta DMA + Semrush SEO + HubSpot Content
paths.portfolio: Campaign plan, GA4 dashboard, SEO audit, paid media ROI model
paths.employers: D2C brands, agencies, SaaS growth teams, marketplaces
paths.ctcLogic: 30 LPA possible in growth roles when the candidate proves acquisition economics and analytics, not only campaign setup
paths.action: Build one end-to-end growth case for a real product

paths.stack: PSPO I + Amplitude Academy + Google BI + Jira + Pendo Product-led
paths.portfolio: PRD, backlog, funnel/cohort analysis, product teardown, prioritization matrix
paths.employers: SaaS, fintech, edtech, product startups, GCC product teams
paths.ctcLogic: Product roles pay more when business judgment + analytics + customer understanding are visible
paths.action: Build 2 product teardowns and 1 analytics case study

paths.stack: CSSC Green Belt + Power Platform + SAP Learning + Power BI
paths.portfolio: DMAIC project, process map, automation workflow, cost saving model
paths.employers: Manufacturing, logistics, consulting, shared services, GCCs
paths.ctcLogic: Operations pay improves when candidates quantify savings and automate processes
paths.action: Do one DMAIC project and one automation project

paths.stack: ISC2 CC + ISACA Cybersecurity Fundamentals + Google Cybersecurity + Power BI
paths.portfolio: Risk register, controls matrix, incident response report, compliance dashboard
paths.employers: Big 4 risk advisory, IT audit, banking risk, cyber consulting
paths.ctcLogic: Non-coding cyber-GRC roles can suit MBA graduates if they prove controls and risk thinking
paths.action: Build GRC portfolio with 3 artifacts and study security basics daily

paths.stack: UCI HR Analytics + Power BI + SAP SuccessFactors Learning + AI Business Professional
paths.portfolio: Attrition dashboard, HR KPI framework, HRIS process map, AI HR use-case policy
paths.employers: HR analytics teams, HR tech, consulting, shared services
paths.ctcLogic: 30 LPA is harder in pure HR freshers, but HR tech/people analytics improves ceiling
paths.action: Build attrition dashboard and workforce planning case

paths.stack: PL-300 + CFI Corporate Finance + Bloomberg BMC + QuickBooks + Excel portfolio
paths.portfolio: 3-statement model, budget vs actual dashboard, valuation summary, market brief
paths.employers: GCC finance, FP&A teams, fintech, consulting, research firms
paths.ctcLogic: Finance CTC rises with modeling depth, analytics tools and sector understanding
paths.action: Build finance model + Power BI finance dashboard
